mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important techniques in inferential statistics."
Hypothesis testing is one of the most important techniques in inferential statistics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to information that already exists and has been collected by other researchers or organisations."
Secondary data refers to information that already exists and has been collected by other researchers or organisations.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of the: A) Average value of a dataset B) Spread of a dataset C) Shape of a distribution in terms of its peakedness and tails D) Number of class intervals 4."
Kurtosis is a measure of the: A) Average value of a dataset B) Spread of a dataset C) Shape of a distribution in terms of its peakedness and tails D) Number of class intervals 4.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the study is conducted without allowing personal opinions, expectations, or preferences to influence the results."
Objectivity in Planning and Execution Objectivity means the study is conducted without allowing personal opinions, expectations, or preferences to influence the results.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to raw data that has been collected but not yet organised into classes."
Ungrouped data refers to raw data that has been collected but not yet organised into classes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method in which participants are selected based on factors other than random chance."
Non-Probability Sampling Non-probability sampling is a method in which participants are selected based on factors other than random chance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a critical first step in any data analysis process."
Planning a statistical investigation is a critical first step in any data analysis process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used when the dataset is large or when values span a wide range."
Grouped data is used when the dataset is large or when values span a wide range.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to model random events that occur over time or space at a constant average rate."
The Poisson distribution is used to model random events that occur over time or space at a constant average rate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tentative statement or assumption about a population characteristic, such as its mean, proportion, or variance."
A hypothesis is a tentative statement or assumption about a population characteristic, such as its mean, proportion, or variance.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statistical technique used to compare the means of three or more groups to determine whether significant differences exist among them."
Analysis of Variance (ANOVA) is a statistical technique used to compare the means of three or more groups to determine whether significant differences exist among them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sampling method in which every member of the population has a known and non-zero chance of being selected."
Probability Sampling Probability sampling is a sampling method in which every member of the population has a known and non-zero chance of being selected.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a measure of how likely an event is to occur."
Probability is a measure of how likely an event is to occur.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as the average of the powers of deviations from a chosen point, often the mean."
Definition and Types of Moments A moment is defined as the average of the powers of deviations from a chosen point, often the mean.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a single numerical value used to estimate a population parameter."
A point estimate is a single numerical value used to estimate a population parameter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method in which the researcher watches and records events, behaviours, or conditions as they naturally unfold."
Observation is a method in which the researcher watches and records events, behaviours, or conditions as they naturally unfold.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simplest measure of dispersion."
The range is the simplest measure of dispersion.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a statistical method used to understand how one variable (the dependent variable, Y) is influenced or predicted by one or more other variables (the independent variables, X)."

Concept of Regression Regression analysis is a statistical method used to understand how one variable (the dependent variable, Y) is influenced or predicted by one or more other variables (the independent variables, X).

______ is used when members of the target population are difficult to locate.
Snowball sampling
Snowball Sampling Snowball sampling is used when members of the target population are difficult to locate.
______ is one of the most important tools for collecting, organising, analysing, interpreting, and presenting data to support effective decision- making.
Statistics
Statistics is one of the most important tools for collecting, organising, analysing, interpreting, and presenting data to support effective decision- making.

Regression analysis
Regression analysis is a statistical method used to model such relationships.

Variance
Variance is a key concept in financial risk analysis, quality control, and forecasting, as it helps quantify uncertainty.
______ are the range, variance, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation.
Four common measures
Four common measures are the range, variance, standard deviation, and coefficient of variation.
______ is a statistical technique used to examine how two or more independent variables collectively influence or predict a single dependent variable.
Multiple regression
Multiple regression is a statistical technique used to examine how two or more independent variables collectively influence or predict a single dependent variable.
______ is the value that appears most frequently in a dataset.
mode
The mode is the value that appears most frequently in a dataset.
______ is a statistical tool that helps transform raw data into a more organised format, allowing patterns to be seen clearly.
frequency distribution
A frequency distribution is a statistical tool that helps transform raw data into a more organised format, allowing patterns to be seen clearly.
______ is the statement that challenges the null hypothesis.
alternative hypothesis
Alternative Hypothesis The alternative hypothesis is the statement that challenges the null hypothesis.
______ is the square root of the variance.
Standard deviation
Standard deviation is the square root of the variance.
______ is a non-parametric statistical method used to examine relationships between categorical variables or to determine whether observed data fit an expected distribution.
Chi-Square Test
The Chi-Square Test is a non-parametric statistical method used to examine relationships between categorical variables or to determine whether observed data fit an expected distribution.
______ is a hypothesis testing procedure used to determine whether three or more population means are equal.
ANOVA
ANOVA is a hypothesis testing procedure used to determine whether three or more population means are equal.
______ is the middle value when the data are arranged in ascending or descending order.
median
The median is the middle value when the data are arranged in ascending or descending order.
______ is a technique used in regression analysis to determine the best-fitting line by minimising the sum of squared differences between the observed values and the fitted line.
least squares method
The least squares method is a technique used in regression analysis to determine the best-fitting line by minimising the sum of squared differences between the observed values and the fitted line.
______ is a sequence of observations recorded over regular time intervals such as hours, days, months, quarters, or years.
time series
A time series is a sequence of observations recorded over regular time intervals such as hours, days, months, quarters, or years.
______ is the most commonly used continuous distribution in business statistics.
normal distribution
The normal distribution is the most commonly used continuous distribution in business statistics.
